data_line: 5900 natural sentences, 20 words, 3000 Wikipedia and 2900 fiction; 200 minimal pairs.
label_line: Model labels (claude-opus-5-5): O 3023, A-gen 956, A-idiom 519, A-def 11, X 1391. Gold: 300 sentences. Cohen's κ (model vs gold, n=300) = 0.862; cross-family check, qwen3.8:27b vs gold: κ = 0.710. The two labelers agree on 80% of all 5,900 sentences (κ = 0.674).

gold.labeler: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), blind to the model labels; no human labels

verdicts.bert: definitions: not supported (underpowered); idioms: between O and A-gen
